audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Gwen Levels 1-2 while whys[0], whys[1] and the Lvl 1-2 spike all say Malphite out-stats her there. The mirror audit (audits/top/malphite__gwen.json) already resolved this in Gwen's favour.
audit.why: Snip Snip!'s centre cone is true damage, so neither Granite Shield's 10%-max-HP absorb nor his armour reads the early trade correctly, and Malphite has no real answer until Thunderclap and Ground Slam are both up. Seismic Shard poke is real but it is chip, not a losing exchange.
audit.corrected: Chart left as Gwen 1-2 to match the mirror; whys[0], whys[1] and the Lvl 1-2 spike rewritten so they no longer claim the opposite.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force is the pivot of levels 6+ and its cooldown is never given; no basic cooldown appears anywhere either.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s — roughly once per wave state, not a trade tool. Seismic Shard is a flat 8s, Ground Slam a flat 7s, Thunderclap 10s at rank 1. Those flat numbers are what make 'trade in the gap' concrete.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to whys, spikes and the cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two errors. The page calls Unstoppable Force 'point-and-click' twice, and it tells you to drop Hallowed Mist as his R lands so 'his post-R burst whiffs'.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is a dash to a LOCATION, not a targeted ability — it can be sidestepped and it can be body-blocked, which is why it is a flank tool. And because it lands him INSIDE the mist, Hallowed Mist stops protecting you from Malphite himself: Riot's wording is that she can only be targeted by enemies who ENTER the mist. What the mist actually buys you there is immunity from his four teammates standing outside it, which is still the reason to hold it — but the page promised the wrong thing.
audit.corrected: R described as a location dash; the mist line now says it denies his team, not him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Thunderclap is described as an 'auto amp' with no tell.
audit.why: It is an auto-attack reset that then makes his following attacks throw aftershocks — the wind-up is the cue to back off, not the cast.

edits.before: No mist yet, only one Q rank, no E — his Seismic Shard slow-poke and W-amped auto out-stat you in this window, though he still can't kill you outright.
edits.after: Seismic Shard (Q, a flat 8s) chips you, but the centre of Snip Snip! is true damage — Granite Shield and armour both read this trade wrong, so you edge it.

edits.before: He out-pokes you with the move-speed-stealing slow while you have one trading tool — farm safely and don't contest his W-amped autos yet.
edits.after: He pokes with the move-speed-stealing slow, yet has nothing to punish with until Thunderclap and Ground Slam are both up — step in on the 8s gap.

edits.before: Before your Q and mist come online his Seismic Shard slow-poke and W-amped auto out-stat you — this is the one window where Malphite actually wins the trade.
edits.after: Seismic Shard is a flat 8s and Granite Shield absorbs 10% of his max HP, so his poke is real — but your centre snip is true damage, so trade in the gap after his Q.

edits.before: Needlework's ranged poke plus Hallowed Mist let you survive his R engage untargetable in the fog and keep snipping while he has zero follow-up.
edits.after: Needlework's poke plus Hallowed Mist mean his 130-second R engage buys him nothing: his team cannot target you in the fog and he has zero follow-up.

edits.before: You win every 1v1, but his point-and-click R still flanks your team and starts objectives — deny his roam so his armor-stacking value never matters elsewhere.
edits.after: You win every 1v1, but Unstoppable Force is a 1000-range location dash that still flanks your team and starts objectives — deny his roam so his armour never matters.

edits.before: Needlework gives you ranged poke and the takedown-reset chase, and Hallowed Mist means his R-into-W combo finds you untargetable instead of dead.
edits.after: Needlework gives you ranged poke and the takedown-reset chase, and Hallowed Mist means his 130-second R engage brings no teammates in with him.

edits.before: Hold Hallowed Mist for his R engage — drop it as he lands so his knock-up burst whiffs and his teammates can't target you in the fog
edits.after: Hold Hallowed Mist for his 130-second R engage — he lands inside it and can still hit you, but his four teammates outside cannot

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are a touch soft if you haven't hit 6 — he can still Seismic Shard you and disengage the slow — so farm and trade in short E-reset bursts rather than committing. At 6 the lane is yours: when he flashes or walks up his R, save Hallowed Mist and drop it as the unstoppable knock-up lands so his post-R burst whiffs and his teammates can't target you in the fog while you keep snipping. He has no follow-up once R is spent, and every point of armor he stacks only feeds your magic Q and your healing.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are a touch soft if you have not hit 6 — Seismic Shard is a flat 8s and he can still slow-and-disengage — so farm and trade in short E-reset bursts rather than committing. At 6 the lane is yours: Unstoppable Force is a 130-second location dash, so sidestep it or drop Hallowed Mist as it lands. He arrives inside the mist and can still hit you, but his four teammates outside it cannot, and he has no follow-up once R is spent. Every point of armour he stacks only feeds your magic Q and your healing.

edits.before: You shred him harder the more he itemizes — every armor item he buys is wasted against your %-max-HP magic Q, and your passive heals more off his huge HP bar, so straight 1v1s are free. The catch is Unstoppable Force: it's a point-and-click teamfight engage and a roam tool, so even though he loses your duel he can flank a squishy teammate or force objectives. Push your wave, deny his roam, and don't facecheck a missing Malphite near drag — his engage doesn't need to beat you to swing a fight.
edits.after: You shred him harder the more he itemises — every armour item is wasted against your %-max-HP magic Q, and your passive heals more off his huge HP bar, so straight 1v1s are free. The catch is Unstoppable Force: a 1000-range dash to a location on a 130-second cooldown, so it is a flank and a roam tool even though he loses your duel. Push your wave, deny the roam, and do not facecheck a missing Malphite near drag — his engage does not need to beat you to swing a fight.

edits.before: Track Malphite's Unstoppable Force: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Unstoppable Force (R, 130s) is a location dash, not point-and-click — sidestep it, and remember it lands him inside your mist.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Unstoppable Force (R): 130/115/100s — a location dash you can sidestep; it lands him IN your mist, so W denies his team, not him. - Seismic Shard: a flat 8s. - Ground Slam: a flat 7s. - Thunderclap (10s) is an auto reset.

notes: Mirror reused from audits/top/malphite__gwen.json: early to Gwen on true damage, Levels 4-5 even, 2+ items to Gwen — I did not re-derive those and did not change the chart. That mirror also records that Malphite's Q and E carry a bogus 'grounding' derived flag and his R a bogus 'projectile' flag; I did not assert any of the three. Whether Hallowed Mist's protection drops for Malphite the instant his R arrives (versus a frame of untargetability on landing) is not answerable from the kit files — the edit only claims he can hit you once he is inside, which follows directly from Riot's W wording.
